title: Christmas at the Inn
description: Beth Green, a devoted café owner, returns to her hometown of Snow Ridge to help her parents host the town's most cherished tradition, the annual Yuletide Potluck, a holiday potluck that welcomes military families and veterans who might otherwise spend Christmas alone. At her parents' cozy inn, Beth meets Jack Evans, a civil engineer with the military, assigned to oversee projects at the local base over Christmas.

title: A Lot Like Christmas
description: Jessica owns the most popular Christmas tree lot in Hudson Springs, but when big-city marketing executive Clay Moore moves a big box chain store into the area and starts selling trees, Jessica finds her business in jeopardy.

title: When Hope Calls: Brookfield
description: Mountie Fletcher helps Nora rescue a new girl for the orphanage; Hannah Lawrence arrives in Brookfield to sell her uncle's ranch as Sam tests out being a rancher.

title: Our Christmas Wedding
description: Roles reverse as Nicole's boss plans newly engaged Nicole and Michael's wedding in two weeks at Christmas.

title: The Art of Christmas
description: After her latest gallery exhibition literally goes up in flames, struggling artist Liv James accepts a teaching job at a local elementary school to make ends meet.

title: A Christmas Prayer
description: Struggling with creative burnout, a children's book illustrator finds unexpected inspiration when she learns about a girl's Christmas wish for her recently widowed father to find happiness again.

title: A Paris Christmas Waltz
description: Emma encounters a professional dancer Leo, whose enthusiasm for competitive dancing is diminishing. However, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presents itself for the novice to join the pro.

title: A Royal Date for Christmas
description: When a European Duke arrives in the US, he realizes that his bags have been lost in transit; he has no choice but to be styled, and ultimately inspired, by Bella, the owner of a local boutique.

title: Home Sweet Christmas
description: Sparks fly between a successful attorney and her childhood friend after they both inherit her late great-uncle's sprawling patch of sugar maple forest.

description: Theater director Lila must rise to the challenge of putting on the perfect Christmas ballet alongside a difficult new colleague, while also discovering her office secret Santa in the process.

title: A Belgian Chocolate Christmas
description: A photographer takes her best friend's place at a Belgian culinary school during the holidays and connects with the chocolatier leading the class. A case of mistaken identity impacts their blossoming romance.
